release: PHP 5.4.16 for RHEL 7 Security Backport RC6
evidence_origin: Externally reported Ubuntu-based test, source logs not included in this release

categories.risk: On an allocator limit breach PHP terminates its worker immediately; userland shutdown/error handlers and normal cleanup may not run
categories.mitigation: Scope affected apps and alert on worker termination; enforce request limits and reserve capacity; provide restart/rollback procedures

categories.risk: RFC1867 session.upload_progress callback is deliberately disabled even if php.ini reports On; dependent upload progress UI or state will not work
categories.mitigation: Inventory application upload-progress consumers, use application-supported alternative, verify multipart uploads separately
